recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man in a distressed cream sweater against a dramatic sunset sky, featuring a horizontal typographic header split between a bold sans-serif and a delicate serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden light from the left side illuminating the subject's face and sweater texture.
Contrast between the heavy, tactile knit of the clothing and the soft, ethereal clouds.
Typographic balance between a wide, geometric name and a small, organic subtitle.
Subject's downward gaze creating a mood of introspection and quietude.
coreInvariants: Distressed texture on the cream-colored garment
Horizontal text alignment in the upper third of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally aligned, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hands clasped at the center-bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the high-contrast text at the top, moves down the subject's face following his gaze to his hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dedicated to the sky and typography, providing breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and muted orange in the sky and highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and desaturated blues in the shadows and lower clouds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream/off-white of the sweater providing a bright central focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky highlights transitioning to low-saturation, dark values at the bottom edge.
paletteRestrictions: Limit cool tones to the background shadows

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif paired with a classic transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Wide tracking, uniform stroke weight, open apertures.
Secondary text: Italicized, high stroke contrast, lowercase.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'A' in the primary text feature wide, stable stances.
The secondary text is struck through with a thin horizontal line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between modern geometric stability and traditional calligraphic elegance.
graphicDevices: Horizontal strikethrough line on the subtitle text.

avoid: Heavy bold weights for the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the open, geometric, and modern feel of the primary name.
Provides the necessary classic, high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with messy hair and a beard looking down, wearing a cream-colored distressed knit sweater. The background is a dramatic sunset with orange, yellow, and dark purple clouds. Lighting is warm and directional from the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main name in a wide, black geometric sans-serif in the top left. Place the secondary title in a smaller, black serif italic with a horizontal line through it in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the sweater texture highly visible?
Is the text legible against the sky?
Is the color palette dominated by warm sunset tones?
Is the subject's gaze directed downward?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress/holes in the sweater
Tracking width of the primary font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact placement of holes in the sweater
postGenerationChecks: Check that the strikethrough line on the subtitle is thin and centered.
Ensure the man's hands are visible and clasped.
Verify the cream color of the sweater doesn't blow out into pure white.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in textured neutral clothing + dramatic natural lighting + split-style minimalist header typography.
